title: Technology Sector Update for 01/15/2019: GSIT,PLAN,ZIXI
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT +2.67%
AAPL +1.70%
IBM +1.05%
CSCO +1.69%
GOOG +2.86%
Technology stocks were firming Tuesday, with the shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 adding more than 1.5% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising almost 0.7%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) GSI Technology ( GSIT ) soared 15.5% on Tuesday after the fabless chipmaker raised its fiscal Q3 revenue guidance to a new range of $14.6 million to $14.8 million compared with its prior outlook expecting between $12.8 million to $13.8 million. Analyst estimates were not available.
In other sector news:
(-) Zix ( ZIXI ) was down 1.3% on Tuesday after the cyber-security company said it was acquiring privately held AppRiver for $275 million in cash and also said it has secured a new $175 million term loan and a $25 million revolving credit facility from SunTrust Bank and Keybanc Capital Markets. Zix also received an additional $100 million through a convertible preferred equity investment by True Wind Capital.
